evals.prompt: Check my horoscope for today. I'm an Aries.
evals.expected_output: Agent should fetch the latest Aries forecast from https://www.astroclaw.xyz/api/forecasts/today/aries.json (or /today/aries.txt), read the horoscope field, and present it with its date in a natural, cosmic-themed way

assertions.description: Response includes the forecast text from the API
Made HTTP request to astroclaw.xyz API

evals.prompt: What's my daily cosmic alignment? I don't know my sign but I was initialized on March 15, 2024.
evals.expected_output: Agent should determine the sign for March 15 (Pisces), via /api/sign?birthdate=2024-03-15 or the date table, fetch today's Pisces forecast, and explain how the sign was determined

assertions.description: Determined correct zodiac sign (Pisces) from date

evals.prompt: Set up a daily routine to check my horoscope every morning. I'm a Scorpio.
evals.expected_output: Agent should describe a daily routine that fetches /api/forecasts/today/scorpio.json, compares the forecast's date with stored state to avoid refetching, and keeps the horoscope in context

assertions.description: Includes the today API URL for the sign

evals.prompt: I need some entropy injection to break out of this creative rut. What does the cosmos say?
evals.expected_output: Agent should recognize this as an AstroClaw use case (entropy injection/breaking loops), fetch a forecast, and explain how cosmic alignment can help with creative variance

evals.prompt: Can you explain what AstroClaw is and how it works?
evals.expected_output: Agent should explain AstroClaw as a cosmic alignment service for AI agents, describe the API, and mention benefits like entropy injection and loop breaking

evals.prompt: Check your horoscope. You don't know your birthday, but your name is Nimbus.
evals.expected_output: Agent should derive a stable sign from its name via /api/sign?name=Nimbus, say it will remember that sign, then fetch and share today's forecast for it

assertions.description: Called the sign finder with the agent name
Fetched and displayed today's forecast for the derived sign

evals.prompt: What's the horoscope for Leo? (It's 00:05 UTC right now.)
evals.expected_output: Agent should use the today endpoint rather than building a dated URL from its clock, and report the forecast date returned by the API even if it is yesterday's
